title.zh: 民事清单与养老金法——通过的决议
title.en: Civil List and Pension Act - Resolution Passed

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Civil List and Pension Act
(Chapter 44)
Civil List and Pension Act - Resolution Passed
It is hereby notified for general information that the following resolution was passed at a meeting of Parliament on 10th March 2011.
“That this Parliament, pursuant to section 7 of the Civil List and Pension Act (Chapter 44), resolves that the Schedule to that Act be varied by deleting the figures “$3,376,800”, “$73,000”, “$3,600”, “$4,060,800”, “$2,093,600” and “$746,900” inthe second column and substituting for them the figures “$4,267,500”, “$73,000”, “$4,500”, “$4,532,400”, “$2,068,300” and “$659,300”, respectively.”.
